title: Core switch 802.1Q native VLAN mismatch causing packet drop
description: Inter-VLAN traffic between engineering and finance is experiencing severe packet loss. Switch trunk port Gi1/0/1 reports native VLAN mismatch error.
reference_resolution: Align native VLAN across trunk ports on both switches to VLAN 999. Clear dynamic MAC address learning table and test inter-VLAN ping.

title: Floor 2 office DHCP scope depleted - clients getting 169.254 addresses
description: Morning employees in Floor 2 cannot obtain valid IP address. Windows displays 169.254.x.x APIPA address.
reference_resolution: Shorten DHCP lease time from 7 days to 4 hours and purge expired leases using Remove-DhcpServerv4Lease.

title: Internal microservice DNS lookup failing with SERVFAIL
description: Backend containers cannot resolve internal-billing.corp.local. DNS query to primary domain controller returns SERVFAIL.
reference_resolution: Restart DNS server service on primary domain controller, clear DNS cache with Clear-DnsServerCache, and verify upstream forwarders.

title: Corporate Wi-Fi rejecting laptops after RADIUS certificate renewal
description: Laptops fail to connect to WPA3-Enterprise SSID. NPS server Event Log shows EAP-TLS failure code 16.
reference_resolution: Rebind renewed Enterprise CA certificate in NPS network policy and push intermediate CA bundle to devices via MDM.

title: SSH and Git clone hanging over IPsec tunnel due to MTU size
description: Developers connecting over IPsec VPN experience frozen terminal sessions on large git payloads.
reference_resolution: Enable TCP MSS clamping to 1360 bytes on VPN tunnel interface and permit ICMP Type 3 Code 4 fragmentation needed.

title: APIPA address assigned on executive boardroom wired Ethernet
description: Boardroom conference laptop unable to connect to internal network; Ethernet port receives 169.254 address.
reference_resolution: Clear exhausted DHCP lease reservations on subnet scope and reboot access switch port.

title: Internal intranet domain name unresolvable after DNS maintenance
description: Users across headquarters report intranet.corp.local returns NXDOMAIN.
reference_resolution: Flush DNS resolver cache on client machines and restart BIND forwarder daemon on secondary DNS server.

title: Wi-Fi authentication loop on Corporate-Secure network
description: Mobile devices and laptops prompt repeatedly for credentials without connecting to office Wi-Fi.
reference_resolution: Verify RADIUS shared secret on wireless LAN controller and re-issue client root certificates.

title: Exchange Online incoming mail backlog with 451 4.7.500 Server busy
description: Incoming customer emails delayed by over an hour. Exchange message trace indicates deferred delivery.
reference_resolution: Whitelist high-volume inbound relay IP in Exchange Enhanced Filtering and adjust inbound connector rate limits.

title: Marketing transactional emails bouncing with DMARC rejection 550
description: Emails sent from SendGrid using corporate domain fail delivery with 550 5.7.26 DMARC policy rejection.
reference_resolution: Add SendGrid include statement to public DNS SPF record and create CNAME records for custom 2048-bit DKIM keys.

title: Outlook crashing on startup due to oversized 50GB OST data file
description: Outlook fails to launch with Application Error Event ID 1000 in OUTLOOK.EXE.
reference_resolution: Rename corrupted outlook.ost file to .old, launch Outlook to regenerate fresh data store, and set sync slider to 1 year.

title: New team member cannot view shared department inbox in Outlook
description: FullAccess permission granted on customer-service mailbox, but mailbox is not auto-mapping in Outlook.
reference_resolution: Remove and re-grant mailbox permissions with AutoMapping set to false, then manually add mailbox in Outlook Advanced settings.

title: Critical vendor invoice quarantined as false positive phishing
description: Legitimate vendor invoice PDF blocked by email security gateway as High Confidence Phishing.
reference_resolution: Inspect threat sandbox report, release message from security admin quarantine with override, and add vendor domain to allowlist.

title: Outgoing company emails marked as spam by Google Workspace recipients
description: Clients using Gmail report our sales quotes are landing in their Spam folder.
reference_resolution: Validate SPF record syntax ensuring under 10 DNS lookups and align DKIM signing selector.

title: Outlook disconnected and prompts for password continuously
description: User Outlook client reports Disconnected and repeated credential prompt fails to accept valid password.
reference_resolution: Clear stored Office credentials in Windows Credential Manager and recreate Outlook mail profile.

title: GlobalProtect VPN gateway timeout Error 504 on remote workers
description: Remote employees in Chicago cannot connect to VPN. Client reports gateway not responding.
reference_resolution: Disable IPv6 binding on client Wi-Fi adapter and switch connection to secondary backup VPN gateway.

title: Conditional access policy blocking employee traveling abroad (Error 53003)
description: Engineer traveling in Europe blocked from accessing Microsoft 365 services due to location policy.
reference_resolution: Create temporary approved location exception in Entra ID Conditional Access and clear user sign-in risk flag.

title: Okta SAML SSO login failing with InResponseTo mismatch error
description: Users logging into Salesforce through Okta receive SAML response status code Responder.
reference_resolution: Synchronize NTP clocks between identity provider and service provider and update ACS URL in SAML configuration.

title: Okta Verify Touch ID biometric attestation loop on MacBook
description: Developer unable to authenticate with Touch ID in Okta Verify; app loops back to password prompt.
reference_resolution: Reset biometric Touch ID enclave using bioutil, re-enroll fingerprint in macOS, and re-link Okta Verify account.

title: DevOps engineer denied access to production SSH bastion
description: SSH connection to bastion returns Permission denied (publickey) due to expired Vault certificate.
reference_resolution: Request new signed SSH certificate from HashiCorp Vault with required principals and connect specifying certificate path.

title: GlobalProtect VPN tunnel dropping during video conference calls
description: VPN client disconnects intermittently every 20 minutes while working from home.
reference_resolution: Lower VPN client MTU setting to 1360 and clear saved gateway authentication tokens in preferences.

title: Intune compliant device status lost after operating system upgrade
description: Workstation blocked from accessing enterprise apps because device marked non-compliant.
reference_resolution: Run manual sync in Intune Company Portal, verify TPM and Secure Boot status, and refresh compliance status.

title: Laptop CPU locked at 0.79 GHz under compilation workload
description: Software engineer reports heavy IDE slowdown; CPU clock speed capped at 798 MHz despite low utilization.
reference_resolution: Connect 130W OEM power adapter instead of low-wattage USB-C charger and update BIOS firmware to resolve throttling.

title: External dual 4K monitors flickering black on Thunderbolt 4 dock
description: Dual external displays connected to Thunderbolt dock go dark for 2 seconds every few minutes.
reference_resolution: Update dock firmware to latest release, disable Panel Self-Refresh in Intel graphics console, and use certified DP 1.4 cables.

title: Warehouse Zebra label printer crashing Windows Print Spooler
description: Packing line stopped because shipping labels fail to print and spoolsv.exe crashes repeatedly.
reference_resolution: Stop print spooler, delete corrupted files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, restart spooler, and upgrade ZDesigner driver.

title: BSOD CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED and NVMe SSD entered read-only mode
description: Developer laptop crashes to blue screen and reports no bootable device; SMART shows wear at 100%.
reference_resolution: Boot into Linux live USB, image user data to external drive using ddrescue, and replace failed NVMe drive.

title: Poly Studio conference room video bar not detected in Teams Room
description: Meeting room console shows camera and microphone disconnected prior to board meeting.
reference_resolution: Power-cycle USB extender transceivers, reset USB root hub in Device Manager, and verify Poly Studio connection.

title: Dell Precision workstation overheating and shutting down
description: Workstation fan running at maximum speed with emergency thermal shutdown during 3D rendering.
reference_resolution: Clean dust blockage from CPU cooling heatsink, re-apply thermal paste, and update BIOS thermal tables.

title: Zebra barcode printer feeding blank labels between print jobs
description: Shipping station printer misaligned and prints across label boundaries.
reference_resolution: Perform gap sensor calibration via Zebra Setup Utilities and verify label dimension configuration.

title: Intune application deployment failing with Fatal Error 1603
description: Enterprise software deployment to workstations fails with error code 0x80070643 / 1603 in AgentExecutor.log.
reference_resolution: Clear pending reboot registry flag, add /qn /norestart parameters to MSI command, and deploy cleanly.

title: macOS Gatekeeper blocking internal developer CLI as unverified developer
description: Mac users unable to open internal tool; system warns app cannot be checked for malicious software.
reference_resolution: Remove com.apple.quarantine attribute via xattr -d, click Open Anyway in Privacy settings, and notarize binary.

title: VS Code Remote SSH host key verification failed after server rebuild
description: Developer cannot connect to cloud VM; error states remote host identification has changed.
reference_resolution: Remove old host key using ssh-keygen -R <server-ip> and accept new fingerprint in interactive SSH session.

title: npm install failing with SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN on office network
description: Node.js package installation fails due to corporate proxy SSL inspection certificate.
reference_resolution: Configure npm cafile setting pointing to corporate root certificate bundle in C:\Certs\CorporateRootCA.crt.

title: WSL2 installation failing with error 0x80370102 on Windows 11
description: Developer unable to launch WSL2 Ubuntu; error reports virtualization is disabled.
reference_resolution: Enable hypervisorlaunchtype auto via bcdedit, enable VirtualMachinePlatform Windows feature, and verify VT-x in BIOS.

title: pip install failing with SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED in Python
description: Python pip command unable to connect to PyPI over corporate network.
reference_resolution: Set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable pointing to corporate trusted root certificate bundle.

title: Docker Desktop failing to initialize Hyper-V backend
description: Docker Desktop startup fails with error: Virtualization not enabled in BIOS.
reference_resolution: Enable Windows Virtual Machine Platform feature and update WSL kernel components via wsl --update.

title: Active Directory user account locking out repeatedly every minute
description: Employee account locks immediately upon unlock; PDC logs show BadPwdCount incrementing from internal IP.
reference_resolution: Locate caller computer from Event ID 4740 on PDC, clear stale credentials in Windows Credential Manager, and unlock account.

title: Logon failure due to Kerberos clock skew exceeding 5 minutes
description: User cannot log into domain PC; Event Log records KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW Event ID 14.
reference_resolution: Re-register Windows time service, force time resync with Domain Controller via w32tm /resync, and purge klist tickets.

title: AWS CLI failing with ExpiredToken during Terraform deployment
description: CI deployment fails with error The security token included in the request is expired.
reference_resolution: Re-authenticate with AWS SSO CLI and extend maximum session duration on the IAM role to 4 hours.

title: Employee unable to complete SSPR because SMS verification code never arrives
description: Locked-out user cannot reset password via self-service portal.
reference_resolution: Verify identity via secure video call, issue temporary access pass (TAP), and correct phone number to E.164 format.

title: Departed contractor retaining access to GitHub organization repos
description: HR confirms contractor departure, but user remains in GitHub organization due to SCIM lag.
reference_resolution: Manually revoke SAML identity link in GitHub Org settings and trigger manual group push in Okta.

title: Domain user locked out by legacy scheduled task with old password
description: User account repeatedly locked out at midnight every night.
reference_resolution: Identify scheduled task on server running under user account, update task to use gMSA, and unlock domain account.

title: Kerberos ticket authentication failing on file server share
description: User receives access denied opening shared departmental drive after password change.
reference_resolution: Run klist purge to flush stale Kerberos tickets and reconnect network mapped drive.

title: PostgreSQL RDS connection pool exhausted with FATAL remaining connection slots
description: Billing service throws 500 errors; RDS active connections hit 100/100 limit with 95% CPU.
reference_resolution: Terminate locking long-running queries with pg_terminate_backend, increase max_connections, and deploy PgBouncer connection pooling.

title: MySQL read replica lagging by 3,500 seconds behind primary
description: Analytics dashboard shows stale metrics; Seconds_Behind_Master growing steadily.
reference_resolution: Enable multi-threaded replica applier with replica_parallel_workers=8 and verify replication catches up to primary.

title: Redis cluster memory saturated and failing writes with OOM command not allowed
description: Web sessions dropping; Redis cluster memory at 100% due to unexpired analytics keys.
reference_resolution: Configure maxmemory-policy to allkeys-lru, purge orphaned analytics keys, and ensure application keys include TTL.

title: MongoDB replica set has no primary node (NotWritablePrimary error)
description: Application writes failing across cluster; mongosh rs.status() shows all nodes in SECONDARY.
reference_resolution: Restore network connectivity to partition witness node, re-evaluate quorum, and verify primary elected successfully.

title: SQL Server Error 1105: Could not allocate space for object in tempdb
description: ERP database transactions rolling back due to exhausted disk space on TempDB drive.
reference_resolution: Kill runaway query session performing Cartesian product, shrink TempDB files, and pre-allocate data files with equal autogrowth.

title: PostgreSQL deadlock detected in concurrent transaction batch
description: Application logs report deadlock detected during simultaneous inventory updates.
reference_resolution: Refactor database transaction to enforce consistent row lock ordering across concurrent workers.

title: MySQL replication stopped with Error 1062 Duplicate entry
description: Replica SQL thread halted due to primary key conflict on reporting table.
reference_resolution: Inject GTID skip transaction on replica, restart slave thread, and set read_only=ON on replica instance.

title: Kubernetes pod CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled exit code 137
description: Microservice pods restarting continuously; kubectl describe shows OOMKilled Exit Code 137.
reference_resolution: Increase pod memory limits from 512Mi to 2Gi in deployment spec and fix unclosed file stream in application code.

title: Java Spring Boot API experiencing 5-second garbage collection pauses
description: p99 latency spikes to 5,000ms; GC logs show Full GC Allocation Failure pauses.
reference_resolution: Switch JVM garbage collector to G1GC with -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 and analyze heap dump for memory leaks.

title: Node.js API event loop lag exceeding 1.8 seconds under concurrent traffic
description: API response times degrade under load; prometheus reports high nodejs_eventloop_lag_seconds.
reference_resolution: Offload synchronous cryptographic hashing to worker threads, replace sync file operations, and scale pods horizontally.

title: AWS Application Load Balancer returning 504 Gateway Timeout during sale
description: Customers experiencing 504 errors on checkout; ALB metrics show elevated TargetResponseTime.
reference_resolution: Adjust ALB idle timeout to align with backend keep-alive, scale target group capacity, and optimize slow checkout query.

title: Nginx Ingress controller returning 502 Bad Gateway on large JWT requests
description: Users logging in via SSO receive 502; ingress logs report upstream sent too big header.
reference_resolution: Add proxy-buffer-size: 128k and proxy-buffers-number: 4 annotations to Ingress resource and trim cookie payload.

title: Container memory leak causing nightly pod eviction in production
description: Worker service pod memory steadily climbs over 12 hours until Kubernetes evicts pod.
reference_resolution: Inspect application memory profile with pprof, fix unbounded in-memory cache, and configure rolling restart policy.

title: JVM Metaspace OutOfMemoryError in Java microservice
description: Java application crashes with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace under heavy classloading.
reference_resolution: Increase MaxMetaspaceSize parameter and resolve classloader leak in runtime dependency injection.

title: Node.js microservice freezing during bulk report export
description: Main thread blocked for 8 seconds when user triggers 50,000 row CSV export.
reference_resolution: Move CSV export generation to background job queue worker and stream response to user.

title: AWS ALB connection drop during rolling deployment update
description: Occasional 502 Bad Gateway errors observed during automated deployment rollout.
reference_resolution: Configure ALB target group deregistration delay to 60 seconds and implement graceful SIGTERM shutdown in backend.

title: Nginx ingress rejecting file uploads with 413 Request Entity Too Large
description: Users unable to attach 30MB diagnostic logs in customer support web portal.
reference_resolution: Add proxy-body-size: 50m annotation to Kubernetes Ingress manifest and reload ingress controller.
